{{Youmay|the comet|the [[Big One/Legends|Big One]], a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] located within the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]}}
The '''Big One''' was a large [[Comet/Legends|comet]] that was located within the [[Cularin comet cloud]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Comet Broom Service]] attempted to send the comet into the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], as part of the [[Cometary Water Reclamation Project]], an operation that had been commissioned by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]]. Ezzar sabotaged the project in an attempt to discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], by framing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] as being involved in the operation and making it appear that the Jedi wanted to crash the comet into the [[Almas Sith fortress]] on the surface of the planet, thereby putting the planet's inhabitants at risk. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] thwarted the plot and prevented the Big One from crashing into Almas.
